prospective_note: the population is D-231's mutation corpus, built on 2026-09-12 from the eight libraries' default-branch tips; every case existed before this protocol was frozen. This is a recall measurement on injected defects, not a shadow over traffic.
unit: one forward mutation case of mutations-v1 (D-231): base = the library's recorded default-branch tip, head = that tip with one recorded crash mutation applied as one commit -- an `if ...: raise ...` validation deleted, a `<=`/`<` (or `>=`/`>`) boundary swapped, or an `if x is None: return ...` guard deleted -- re-created on the runner from the site the sample records (kind, path, line, replacement, span)
selection: from the 122 forward cases of the local corpus, a stratified random sample of 5 per library (8 libraries, 40 cases), drawn by random.Random(f'{seed}:{library}').sample over the library's forward cases sorted by instance id, then ordered round-robin across libraries in name order. The seed is silent_audit_seed. The sample is written before any unit runs and never re-drawn.
denominator: the 40 sampled cases. A case the cap refuses, that fails to build on the runner, or that the product refuses is a miss and is named; the denominator does not shrink.
numerator: cases whose review certifies at least one receipt (a certification row with outcome accepted).
also_reported: how many of the 40 the frame rule of D-232 sends to the drawer -- a verification row deferred as `behavior change confirmed, intent unknown` whose wording names a changed line or a path through one -- because a mutation that raises on the line it wrote is exactly the shape D-232 stops publishing; the value class; refusals; and the Wilson 95% interval over 40.
order: round-robin across libraries in name order, so a cost cap removes cases evenly
exclusion_declared_before_any_run: none beyond the sampling rule. No case is excluded after its outcome is known, nothing is re-sampled and nothing is retried.
switches: value_notes_visible and gate_notes_visible on for every unit, so the drawer's lines are recorded to the lines file; contained_attempt_voids at the product default (D-226); intent_replies off (no GitHub client exists on this path)
smoke: before the 40 are bought, exactly one case is run under --limit 1 into trials-smoke.jsonl with the per-unit budget lowered to $0.30 by --unit-budget, a pipeline check that the artifact carries a ledger and a lines file (AGENTS.md section 9), never a measurement: the same case is bought again at $1.00 in the main run and only that trial counts.
truth: known by construction: every case carries one injected defect at a recorded site; a receipt is a detection whether or not its candidate names that site, and the table records the site beside the class so a reader can check
code: the release/batch2 branch of 2026-09-13, which carries D-232 (attest.intent.v5), D-233 and D-234
freeze_at_note: the host clock, UTC, written by the freeze step immediately before the sample is drawn
authorization_erratum: 2026-09-12T00:02Z, before any unit ran and with $0.00 spent: authorization.json's granted_at had been written as 2026-09-12T14:00Z, a calendar guess after the host-clock freeze -- the same erratum e05-external-v1 recorded -- and preflight would have refused it. granted_at is corrected to the UTC instant the work order was received, before this window's first commit, and the protocol digest re-frozen; freeze_at, the sample and the order are untouched, and no outcome existed to influence the correction.
